name: Spiko UK T-Bills Money Market Fund
oneLiner: UKTBL is Spiko's AMF-authorized GBP money-market fund share token, backed by short-dated UK Treasury bills and gated through Spiko's transfer agent.
collateral: GBP-denominated UK Treasury bill money-market exposure administered through Spiko fund rails.
pegMechanism: GBP-denominated NAV-accreting money-market fund share; primary subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko at fund NAV.

jurisdiction.license: UCITS Short-Term VNAV Money Market Fund

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: UKTBL is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: UKTBL Ethereum mint/burn is restricted by Spiko's verified Token.sol implementation and shared authority policy contract; Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Etherlink, Starknet, and Stellar routes remain unresolved.

controls.label: UKTBL token restricted mint/burn
controls.evidence: Ethereum lane reads returned implementation 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74, owner() = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, and authority() = 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472. Source review showed mint and burn are restricted() calls.

controls.label: Spiko authority policy contract
controls.evidence: Token authority() returned this shared policy contract; current policy rules, signer custody, and admin setup were not decoded in this lane.

review.evidence: Verified Ethereum implementation source and direct reads show UKTBL mint/burn routed through Spiko's restricted authority contract rather than an owner EOA.
unresolvedQuestions: Decode the shared Spiko authority policy contract signer/admin setup before adding Safe-like details.
Resolve Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Etherlink, Starknet, and Stellar mint or bridge authorities before claiming multichain completeness.

notices.title: Low-liquidity fund token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats UKTBL as a NAV-priced fund share.
